paper_title: PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024 Improving Reliability of SQL Generation   using Ensemble LLMs
caption: Individual vs Ensemble Models
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for three different models: a 3-Model Ensemble (blue), a 2-Model Ensemble (red), and GPT-4 (yellow). The x-axis represents Cost, ranging from 0 to 10 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 2, and the y-axis represents Reliability Score, ranging from 30 to 90 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 20. The 3-Model Ensemble (blue line with circular markers) starts at a reliability score of approximately 75 at cost 0 and remains relatively stable, ending at around 78 at cost 10. The 2-Model Ensemble (red line with circular markers) begins at a reliability score of about 82 at cost 0 and shows a gradual decline, ending at approximately 72 at cost 10. GPT-4 (yellow line with circular markers) starts at a high reliability score of 90 at cost 0 and exhibits a steep decline, dropping to approximately 38 at cost 10. All lines are solid, and the plot shows that as cost increases, the reliability of GPT-4 decreases significantly, while the ensembles maintain higher and more stable reliability scores.
